ribbon.grpSchedulePersistence.label: Schedule Database Sync
ribbon.btnLoadSchedule.supertip: Fetches the dispatch board, attendance entries, rollup, preferences and teams for the selected date from PostgreSQL or offline storage.
ribbon.btnSaveSchedule.supertip: Validates the board (duplicate workers block the save), rolls punches up into daily attendance and commits everything.
ribbon.grpProjectPersistence.label: Project Database Sync
ribbon.btnLoadProjects.supertip: Fetches project masters, daily summaries and companies from PostgreSQL or offline storage.
ribbon.btnSaveProjects.supertip: Validates and commits all project sheets, daily summaries and companies.
ribbon.grpStaffPersistence.label: Staff Database Sync
ribbon.btnLoadStaff.supertip: Resyncs staff profiles and salary history from SQL Payroll, loads licenses from PostgreSQL, and checks thumbprint controller mismatches.
ribbon.btnSaveStaff.supertip: Validates and commits employee profiles and licenses.
ribbon.grpVehiclePersistence.label: Fleet Database Sync
ribbon.btnLoadVehicles.supertip: Fetches all vehicle master records and logs from PostgreSQL or offline storage.
ribbon.btnSaveVehicles.supertip: Validates and commits fleet specifications, maintenance records and insurance claims.
ribbon.rows.insert.label: Insert Row
ribbon.rows.insert.supertip: Inserts a new formatted row at the top or bottom of the active table (following the Insert at Top toggle) and selects it.
ribbon.rows.insertTop.label: Insert at Top
ribbon.rows.insertTop.supertip: When enabled, typing in the first data row creates a new row at the top. When disabled, rows are appended at the bottom.
ribbon.rows.trim.label: Trim Empty Rows
ribbon.rows.trim.supertip: Scans all tables on the active sheet and trims extra blank rows, leaving exactly one empty entry row.
ribbon.rows.dedupe.label: Remove Duplicates
ribbon.rows.dedupe.supertip: Scans all tables on the active sheet and removes identical duplicate rows, keeping the first occurrence.
ribbon.rows.delete.label: Delete Row
ribbon.rows.delete.supertip: Deletes selected row(s) in absolute master tables. Deletion is blocked on additive transaction tables.
ribbon.rows.total.label: Total Row
ribbon.rows.total.supertip: Shows or hides the summary total row at the bottom of the active table.
ribbon.rows.insertTopOn: Insert at TOP active: Spawns at top, redundant bottom rows trimmed.

ribbon.support.bug.label: Report Bug
ribbon.support.bug.supertip: Captures a screenshot of the current screen and opens a form to describe the problem. Attach screenshots, pasted images or screen recordings and send them to the developer.
ribbon.support.guide.label: Help Guide
ribbon.support.guide.supertip: Opens a floating guide that explains the cell you click: what the column means, whether it is required, its format, dropdowns, automatic values and handy navigation tips. Drag it to any edge of Excel to dock it.
ribbon.support.dictionary.label: Dictionary
ribbon.support.dictionary.supertip: Browse translations, suggest better wording (including Manglish), and vote on community suggestions. Suggestions with 3 votes go live automatically across Portal and Excel.
ribbon.custom.btnPushStaffToTerminal.scr: Push Staff ID & Name to Controller
ribbon.custom.btnPushStaffToTerminal.sup: Compares Staff IDs on the thumbprint controller and updates matching users names (preserving fingerprint templates and roles) after confirmation.
ribbon.custom.grpFuelImport.label: Portal Integration
ribbon.custom.btnImportFuelStatement.sup: Parses monthly PDF invoices or portal Excel files and appends fuel logs into OdometersTable.
ribbon.custom.btnSortAndHealOdometers.su: Sorts all odometer logs chronologically, reads Remarks so edits are never applied twice, normalizes machinery engine hours (0.1 hr), matches cross-card fueling trajectories across the fleet, flags ambiguous or invalid odometers, and recomputes Odometer Before.
ribbon.custom.grpScheduleDay.label: Working Day
ribbon.custom.btnPrevDay.label: Previous Day
ribbon.custom.btnPrevDay.supertip: Loads the schedule for the day before the one on the board.
ribbon.custom.btnToday.label: Today
ribbon.custom.btnNextDay.label: Next Day
ribbon.custom.btnNextDay.supertip: Loads the schedule for the day after the one on the board.
ribbon.custom.grpScheduleBoard.label: Schedule Board
ribbon.custom.btnPrintSchedule.label: Print Schedule
ribbon.custom.btnPrintSchedule.supertip: Exports the Daily Schedule board to a 1-page A4 Landscape PDF (without project/worker times or vehicle odometers) and opens it for printing or sharing.
ribbon.custom.btnRollup.label: Roll Up Attendance
ribbon.custom.btnRollup.supertip: Rebuilds Daily Attendances and the board check-in times from the approved Attendance Entries.
ribbon.custom.btnSyncTerminal.label: Sync Thumbprint Terminal
ribbon.custom.btnSyncTerminal.supertip: Reads all punches from the attendance terminal, saves new entries across all dates to the database, and refreshes the current day.
